meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会获得一批语言服务器（LSP）工具，能检查代码诊断、跳转定义、查找引用、搜索符号、检查并执行重命名。这些工具通过工具调用触发，不是 shell 命令。
howto.when: 当用户要求代码诊断、查看定义或引用、做重命名安全检查等时触发；若诊断提示缺少语言服务器，会先调用状态查询。

say.text: 帮我检查这个项目里有没有编译错误。
say.note: 会运行 diagnostics 检查当前工作区。

say.text: 这个函数是在哪里定义的？
say.note: 触发 goto_definition 定位定义位置。

say.text: 把那个变量安全地重命名为 'total'。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains LSP tools to inspect diagnostics, jump to definitions, find references, search symbols, and check/apply renames. These are invoked as tool calls, not shell commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for code diagnostics, definitions/references, or safe rename checks; if diagnostics report a missing language server, status is checked first.

say_en.text: Check this project for compile errors.
say_en.note: Runs diagnostics on the current workspace.
